name: work-governance
description: Govern goal-driven Codex work with minimal policy, WorkVCS-backed durable state, Git boundaries, and validation.

interface.shortDescription: Govern goal-driven work with WorkVCS-backed state.
interface.longDescription: Work Governance provides the policy layer for Codex work: No-Plan versus Plan-controlled routing, goal discovery, confirmation boundaries, Git and external-risk rules, validation strength, and completion claims. Durable project state is recorded through WorkVCS high-level commands instead of a plugin-local durable-state engine.
defaultPrompt: Use $work-governance:work-lifecycle to apply the minimum governance level needed for this task.
